description:
## [0.0.12](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.11...v0.0.12) (2026-10-16)

### Features

* **Instagram - Download any story:** A video story you filmed gets Download as photo under Download now, which saves one still picture from it at full size. Download still saves the video. Asked for in #215.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** New switch under Download, Download audio, off by default. It adds Download audio to a reel's menu, which saves just the sound as an M4A file to Recordings (Music on Android 11 and older). Asked for in #216.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch under Tab bar, Hide Messages on Home's header, off by default. It's for accounts that still have Instagram's Messages button at the top of Home and turned on Show the Messages tab, which leaves Messages in two places. Asked for in #210.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** New switch under Profiles, Recent unfollowers, off by default. Scroll to the end of your own Followers list and anyone missing since last time shows under Who unfollowed you, with the date. Asked for in #208.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** Recent unfollowers only reads the list Instagram already loaded, so nothing extra is asked of Instagram. The list stays on your phone, kept apart for each account, and Clear unfollower list wipes it. Asked for in #208.
* **Instagram - Story ring size:** Ring color has Teal now, a blue-green that stays easy to see on white and black pages alike. Asked for in #206.
* **Instagram - Hide reels by caption words:** New patch with a switch and a Blocked words list under Reels, off and empty by default. A reel in the Reels tab goes when its caption holds one of your words or phrases, hashtags included. Asked for in #192.
* **Instagram - Hide reels by caption words:** Case doesn't matter. Put a comma or a new line between words, so a list from Hushfeed pastes straight in. Reels you open from a profile, search or a chat still play. Asked for in #192.
* **Instagram - Hide reels by caption words:** Also on Home under the list hides posts on Home with those words in their caption too. That part needs Hide suggested posts in your build. Asked for in #192.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** HushGram's settings come in Italian when your phone is set to Italian. Like the other translations, it's a first draft that a native reader can still improve. Asked for in #194.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch under Downloads, Save every page without asking, off by default. With Download button on feed posts on, a tap on a carousel saves all of its pages at once instead of asking which. Asked for in #190.
* **Instagram - Show a reel's exact time:** New switch, Show how long ago a reel was posted, off by default. It adds a line under the reel's time like 1d 2h 5m ago, in HushGram's language. Searching the patch's name finds both its choices now. Asked for in #195.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Tab order under Tab bar opens a new list, Show and reorder tabs. Check a tab to put it on the bar and drag its handle to move it. Reset brings back Instagram's tabs. Nothing changes until you tap OK. Asked for in #207.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Always Home opens Home again with your tabs reordered in Tab order, and after you swipe Instagram away from recent apps. Both used to open Reels. Coming back while Instagram is still open keeps you where you were. Reported in #55.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Start tab set to Search, Reels or Profile opens on its tab with the tabs reordered too. The diagnostic report counts each start and why a start tab was skipped. Reported in #55.
* **Instagram - Keep a seek bar on Reels:** With Seek bar like DM videos or Bigger seek bar on, the played part and the handle slide along steadily. They used to jump about ten times a second, as often as Instagram updates it. Reported in #10.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With Show content behind the tab bar on, a reel's comment box sat under the navigation bar until the keyboard came up, and other sheets could lose their bottom row. Sheets get their usual space back now. Reported in #209.
* **Instagram - Keep a seek bar on Reels:** A new reel's seek bar starts at the beginning right away. It used to show the last reel's spot for a moment and then jump back to the start, which was most of what you'd see when swiping quickly. Reported in #10.
* **Instagram - Font:** A color emoji font picked as the Font shows in the emoji row above the comment box now, not only in the box. That row used to keep Instagram's old emoji pictures, even after a restart. Reported in #166.
* **Instagram - Font:** A text font or a black and white emoji font leaves that row alone, since it would draw it in black. Emoji the file doesn't have still look like your phone's. Reported in #166.
* **Instagram - Font:** The bio under a profile's name takes the font you picked too. Instagram draws it with its newer text system, which loaded its own font and skipped the swap, and other text drawn that way follows now as well. Reported in #166.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** Once Hide the tab bar on Reels slides the pill away, the reel runs to the bottom of the screen instead of leaving a black band where the pill was. It makes room again when the pill comes back. Reported in #170.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Hide videos, Hide photos, Hide carousels, Hide posts you've liked and Hidden accounts now catch suggested posts on Home too. Instagram 451 wraps each suggested post in a unit those switches didn't look inside. Found while working on #192.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** With Hide the Search tab on, the Search button on Home's header opens search again on phones that swipe between tabs. It used to show a note asking you to turn the switch off. Back returns to Home. Reported in #204.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** The Download button beside a reel now uses Instagram's own icon made for that column, the one Save's is drawn from, so it's the same size and line weight as the buttons above it instead of bigger and bolder. Reported in #198.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With the floating glass bar on, a chat's message box sat too low, half under the keyboard or behind navigation buttons. Chats keep the right space again, and leaving one no longer leaves a black strip under the pill. Reported in #196.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** With full screen on, opening Instagram straight onto Reels, or coming back to Reels from HushGram settings or a chat, could leave black strips at the top and bottom until you switched tabs. Reels fills the screen either way now. Reported in #200.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** With Full screen Home on, the first tab you opened from Home, like Messages or your profile, slid up under the status bar until you switched again. That tab leaves room for the bar now. Reported in #203.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** On a profile with no name, the Follows you or Doesn't follow you label sat on top of the post and follower counts. It takes the line where the name would be now. Reported in #157.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** With full screen on, the keyboard covered a reel's comment box, which sat one navigation bar too low once the keyboard brought that bar back. It sits right above the keyboard now, with the glass tab bar on too. Reported in #209.

### Improvements

* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** Pausing, playing or liking a reel with a tap, and tapping Save or Download, no longer bring Burn-in guard's faded buttons back. Other buttons, the caption, the bars and swiping to the next reel still do. Asked for in #162.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New Dim after choice under Burn-in guard sets how long it waits before fading, from at once to 10 seconds. It starts at 5, as before. Asked for in #162.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** Burn-in guard dims a reel's seek bar now, and the time HushGram shows next to it fades along with it. The Not interested and Interested buttons under some reels fade too. Reported in #162.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** Searching for Download any video now also finds Download button on feed posts and the switch under it.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Listed under Interface in Morphe's patch list now, next to the glass tab bar, since most of its switches are about the tab bar. That keeps Reels short enough to scan with the new caption words patch in it.

### Validation

Validation: 5375 runtime tests passed locally. All 1959 patch tests passed too.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask before a refresh
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Back leaves Home
patches.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change the like animation
patches.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Save button, the Create and Your algorithm buttons and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Clear the media cache
patches.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass 500 MB. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, or mute. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Instagram from sending usage reports and crash reports to Instagram and Facebook. It also skips the contacts and location setup screens. Restart Instagram after you change it. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Don't report screenshots
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't save recent searches
patches.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Emoji style
patches.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Find the reel you came from
patches.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Font
patches.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Full resolution photos
patches.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally while Home does. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels) and Feed (Full screen Home).

patches.name: Glass tab bar
patches.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels and stories, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet. You can still start a group from your messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide highlights
patches.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, and Home's posts too with Also on Home. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the followers and following lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back and suggested threads and people off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, or the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide that you're typing
patches.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. A second switch hides the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create and Profile, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages or Ghost mode button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Share button
patches.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Threads button
patches.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide the home feed
patches.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the notes row
patches.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide your active status
patches.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: HushGram launch screen
patches.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Install next to Instagram
patches.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The second Instagram's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be Instagram's own.
The name under the second Instagram's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.
Puts a small HushGram badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. While its switch is on, it takes the place of Instagram's own long press on a photo. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Open developer options
patches.description: A long press on the Home tab opens Instagram's own developer options, where you can change its hidden settings. A wrong change can break parts of Instagram until you reset it. On once you patch it in. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Developer.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Instagram pages and ads still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read still tells them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Updates.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, at a small or large size. Stories, profiles, Explore and Reels stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu on a comment that has its own photo or GIF, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts the first video on Home with its sound on, the same as tapping the video's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened. A second switch lets you watch 20 reels, then stops swiping for 15 minutes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops two alarms that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, and the other wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on Home from opening the camera. The + button still opens it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Stop swiping between tabs
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe from moving between Home, Reels and the other main tabs. Tapping the tab bar still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Story ring size
patches.description: Draws the rings in the stories row at the top of Home smaller, so more fit on screen, or larger, and the ring of a story you haven't watched in a color you pick. Nothing changes until you pick a size or a color. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Tap a feed video to pause it
patches.description: A tap on the video playing in a feed pauses it in place instead of opening it in Reels, and another tap plays it again. Ads keep Instagram's own tap. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Makes videos, reels and stories wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, like Instagram does when it saves mobile data. A choice under the switch can leave Reels out or hold only Reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness boosts
patches.description: Stops HDR photos and reels from making the screen brighter than everything else. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a post or reel from liking it, and the heart doesn't show. The Like button still works. Separate switches cover posts, reels, comments and chat messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Upload stories at full quality
patches.description: Sends the video stories you post at up to 1080 pixels wide instead of 720, as Instagram does with its own Upload at highest quality setting on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View DM photos and videos anonymously
patches.description: Holds back the Opened notice for view once photos and videos in messages, so the sender doesn't see you opened them. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: View live anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the stories you watch. Replying or reacting still shows you. An optional Mark as seen button lets you choose. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

release_notes:
## [0.0.9](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.8...v0.0.9) (2026-10-11)

### Features

* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** New Unlock with choice. Pick HushGram PIN and a 4 to 8 digit PIN of your own unlocks your messages instead of your phone's lock. It stays on your phone and can't be recovered. Asked for in #134.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** New switch under Feed, Hide 'Are you interested' questions, off by default. It removes the bubble under a Home post that asks if you're interested, with no gap left and nothing answered for you. Asked for in #131.
* **Instagram - Show when someone was last active:** New patch with a switch under Messages, off by default. Active 5m ago under a name in your messages becomes the time itself, like Active at 3:42 PM. It uses the time Instagram already has, so nothing new is requested. Asked for in #132.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the Save button on reels, off by default. The Save button and its count leave the buttons beside a reel, and the rest close up. Posts in your feed keep theirs.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch under Downloads, Hold to download, off by default. Hold two fingers on a feed post or a reel for a second and it saves what's under them. Instagram's one-finger long press doesn't change.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** New switch under Settings entry, Open settings with a long press on your profile's menu, off by default. Holding the three lines on your own profile opens HushGram, and a tap still opens Instagram's menu. Asked for in #84.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch under Tab bar, Center the logo on Home's header, off by default. Instagram's logo sits in the middle of Home's top bar without the newer header's other changes. Asked for in #50.
* **Instagram - Rounded post corners:** New switch under Feed, Rounded corners on posts, off by default, with a small or large size. Photos, videos and carousels in Home and Following get rounded corners. Asked for in #135.
* **Instagram - Upload stories at full quality:** New patch that posts video stories at up to 1080 pixels wide and 9 Mbps instead of 720. Off by default, under Stories in HushGram settings. Asked for in #37.
* **Instagram - Hide paid partnership Reels:** New switch under Reels in HushGram settings, off by default, that keeps Paid partnership and boosted reels out of the Reels tab. Reels you open from search, a profile, Saved or a message still play. Asked for in #12.
* **Instagram - Accent color:** New patch that turns Instagram's blue into purple, pink, red, orange, green or teal after a restart. Off by default, under Layout in HushGram settings. Asked for in #8.
* **Instagram - HushGram launch screen:** New patch that shows HushGram's logo while Instagram starts on Android 13 and newer. Off by default, under Layout in HushGram settings. Asked for in #5.
* **Instagram - Find the reel you came from:** New patch. Tap a reel's author, open their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it. Off by default, under Reels in HushGram settings. Asked for in #30.
* **Instagram - Open developer options:** MetaConfig now lists flag names instead of numbers, and Developer has a Recommended flags page of named On or Off switches that needs Allow importing overrides. Asked for in #91, #25, #110, #50, #37 and #13.
* **Instagram - Install next to Instagram:** New patch that installs a second Instagram beside the first, with its own data and sign-in. It starts unselected in Manager. Asked for in #34, #61, #73 and #121.
* **Instagram - Save comment photo:** It now covers a comment's GIF too, saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, or as the animated WebP or MP4 when that's all Instagram has. Off by default, under Comments in HushGram settings. Asked for in #1.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** New patch that hides the status and navigation bars on Reels and Home, and a swipe from the edge brings them back. Both switches are off by default, under Reels and Feed. Asked for in #14.
* **Instagram - Long press to zoom:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default. Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big, and let go to close it. Asked for in #63.
* **Instagram - Start feed videos with sound:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default, that starts the first video on Home with its sound on. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Asked for in #103.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** Tab bar can now hide as you scroll, and has Tab bar opacity and Tab bar height lists. They're off or Standard by default, under Tab bar in HushGram settings, and a restart shows a change. Refs #87, #65.
* **Instagram - Back leaves Home:** New switch under Feed in HushGram settings, off by default. Back on Home then leaves like Instagram does at the top of the feed, with no scroll up and no reload. Asked for in #54.
* **Instagram - Start Home on Following:** New switch under Feed, Instagram logo on Home, off by default. It needs Start Home on Following and puts Instagram's logo where the feed's name would be. Asked for in #126.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Tab bar has new switches to hide Search, Create or Profile, a Start tab list for where Instagram opens and a Tab order list. Everything starts off or at Instagram's order. Restart Instagram to see a change. Asked for in #20, #55 and #90.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** Tab bar has four new Home header switches that hide Create or notifications, or add a Search or Ghost mode button. All start off, and a restart shows them. Asked for in #70 and #118.
* **Instagram - Start stories with sound:** New switch under Stories in HushGram settings, off by default, that opens a story with its sound on. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Asked for in #103.
* **Instagram - Control taps and volume on Reels:** New choice under Playback, A tap on a reel, that can pause or mute instead of Instagram's default. A switch below it keeps reels muted on the volume keys. Both start at Instagram's behavior.
* **Instagram - Blur the bars around Reels:** New switch under Reels in HushGram settings, off by default, that fills the bars around a reel that doesn't fill the screen with a blurred copy of it. Open Reels again after turning it on.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** New Hide posts you've liked switch and Hidden accounts list under Feed, off or empty by default. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one. Posts leave Home on the next refresh.
* **Instagram - Show hidden like counts:** New patch. Turn on Show like counts the poster hid, under Feed, and the like row shows the number whenever Instagram's server sent it. Off by default.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** The end of HushGram settings has a new row, Support HushGram, that opens my Ko-fi page. It also turns up if you search for coffee or Ko-fi.
* **Instagram - Profile posts as a list:** New patch, off by default, under Profiles in HushGram settings. Opening someone's profile takes you to their posts as a scrolling list, and Back shows the grid.
* **Instagram - Hide your active status:** New patch with a switch under Messages, off by default, so people you chat with don't see Active now for you. Restart Instagram. Ghost mode turns it on too.
* **Instagram - Hide Meta AI:** Three new switches, off by default: Hide the Muse button on your profile, Hide Blend on reels and Hide the Muse card on profiles.
* **Instagram - Default playback quality:** New row under Playback to pick the playback quality with a long press on a tab, from Auto to Highest. Off by default. Asked for in [#93](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/issues/93).
* **Instagram:** Press and hold New message at the top of your inbox to turn all the Ghost mode switches on or off together. A tap still starts a new message.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** New switch under Profiles, Put accounts that don't follow you back first, off by default. It puts them at the top of your Following list. Asked for in #40.
* **Instagram - Keep a seek bar on Reels:** New switch under Reels, Bigger seek bar on reels, off by default. It makes Instagram's seek bar thicker, with a round handle and the time above it. Asked for in #10.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** It can now hide single chats (Hidden chats) or lock them (Locked chats), under Messages in HushGram settings. Open a chat in Instagram first so it's on the list.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New switch, Download button on feed posts, off by default. It puts a download icon beside Save under each post and needs Download feed videos or photos. Asked for in #97, #116 and #117.
* **Instagram - Hide the Reels tab:** New switch, Show the Reels tab, off by default. It puts the tab back after Home when Instagram built your bar without it, and Hide wins if both are on. Asked for in #120.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the comment bar on all reels, off by default. The comment button still opens the comments. Asked for in #119.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** New switch under Reels, Hide the top bar on the Reels tab, off by default. The row with the Reels title and camera goes away and the reel stays put. Reels opened elsewhere keep their bar. Asked for in #14.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. It draws the tab bar as a floating pill of frosted glass with a highlight that slides to your tab. Off by default, under Tab bar, and a restart shows it. Refs #89, #65.
* **Instagram - Saved on your profile:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. It adds a bookmark to your profile's tabs that opens Saved. Turn it on under Profiles in HushGram settings and restart Instagram. Refs #89.
* **Instagram - Stop background wake-ups:** New patch, from @sherifrahim. Two switches under Battery, off by default, stop the alarms that wake your phone in the background. Notifications still arrive. Refs #89.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested stories:** New switch under Stories in HushGram settings, Hide the Music for you card, off by default. Asked for in #111.
* **Instagram - Hide Notes on profile pictures:** New patch with a switch under Profiles in HushGram settings, off by default, that takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, including the prompt to post one on your own. Notes in Messages stay.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - Open developer options:** Import flag names now applies on every Instagram 450 build. On four of them (the x86 and x86_64 builds and two others) it was left out, so MetaConfig kept showing numbers. Asked for in #91.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** Ticking or unticking a chat under Hidden chats now shows in your inbox as soon as you go back to it. Before, the inbox kept its old rows until you pulled to refresh or a new message came in.
* **Instagram - Hide ads:** Sponsored posts inside a page of posts, like Home's Older Posts page and Explore's chain of posts, are gone too, and so are rows of several ads between posts. Diagnostics counts both.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** Typing in the settings search box no longer freezes Instagram on a slow phone.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** A settings export that hits an error now says Couldn't export HushGram settings and lets you try again. Recommended flags does the same.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Home's For you feed no longer grows one post at a time when most of a page is suggestions. It asks for the next page sooner. Reported in #52.
* **Instagram - See who a story mentions:** The label now shows on stories in Instagram's older format, and tapping it opens the list without pausing or skipping the story. Refs #125.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order, instead of just the first. Reported in #78.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Hiding videos, photos, carousels, liked posts or accounts no longer shows the empty feed card while Home is still loading.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** The cover shows its whole title and the Unlock link again on a phone screen.
* **Instagram - Open developer options:** Export overrides no longer writes a file that Import overrides refuses. Reported in #67.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** The chip under a profile's counts grows with your phone's font size instead of cutting its words off. Reported in #24.
* **Instagram - Hide Meta AI:** With Hide Meta AI in search and Home's bar on, a keyword search's results no longer end in an Ask a follow-up bar.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Home no longer sits on gray loading boxes when your feed is all suggestions, like a new account that follows nobody. Asked about in #105 and #104.
* **Instagram - Keep in chat:** A view once or replayable photo or video you send now stays Instagram's own sent bubble instead of turning into an empty one. Refs #114.
* **Instagram - Pure black dark mode:** It now reaches the comments sheet, which stayed gray. Refs #108.
* **Instagram - Save profile picture:** Save profile picture and Copy username and bio now work in the newer pop-up list a profile's three dots open on some accounts. Asked for in #29.
* **Instagram:** HushGram does less background work. Full screen Reels and Home, Saved on your profile, Lock your messages and Find the reel you came from stop checking the screen when there's nothing to do. Reported in #129.
* **Tooling:** The release facts check reads the push gate's kept run again when the pre-push hook starts it in a fresh PowerShell.

### Improvements

* **Instagram:** The check that proves each hook landed in the right place now holds on all seven 450 builds, since it finds methods by what they load and call instead of names that change between builds.
* **Instagram:** HushGram settings open as a list of categories, and a tap opens one on its own page. A button under the status card switches to one long list. Thanks to @talhaeenss for #123. Asked for in #80 and #100.
* **Instagram:** HushGram settings look tidier. Each category's page starts with a line saying what it's for, and every row now has an icon. On the list of categories, the rows share one rounded card the way a section's rows do. Asked for in #130.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** The chip under a profile's counts has a color for each answer, blue, green or red, darker on a light profile. Thanks to @talhaeenss for #124.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** Download all now waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Download all on reels works the same. Asked for in #115.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Download cover now saves the largest picture a post carries, so a reel with a custom cover never saves its first frame instead.
* **Instagram:** When a patch fails on a type it didn't expect, the diagnostic report now names both types.
* **Instagram - Lock your messages:** The cover's Unlock link is darker on a light screen, easier to tap and readable to screen readers.
* **Instagram:** Several patches now look up what they need once instead of every time the screen redraws.
* **Instagram:** The diagnostic report counts each kind of card the stories row loads, so a card no switch covers yet, like the Music for you card in #111, shows up by name.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** Hide shopping now also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products.
* **Tooling:** The patched APK check holds Hide the comment bar on all reels' guard in the right place, and the Clean up Reels tests cover all seven Instagram 450 builds.
* **Tooling:** The patch tests no longer need Instagram 449 or 439 in the fixture folder, and read 450's declared build instead.
* **Tooling:** The all-builds patch run takes only the builds of the Instagram version the catalog declares, and names older ones as skipped.
* **Tooling:** The release preflight finds tests a code-only commit left stale before any Gradle run does, in under a second.
* **Tooling:** Patch tests run by area, so Gradle can reuse results for areas whose inputs haven't changed.
* **Tooling:** Release notes come out in the shape Morphe Manager draws, as short scoped bullets under their type heading, and the release check holds every bullet to that. Asked for in #86.
* **Tooling:** The release checks that apply every patch as one Instagram leave out Install next to Instagram, and its own run checks that the result is a different package.
* **Tooling:** The release notes check now stops a bullet that runs over 40 words, not counting its closing credit, so Manager's card stays short. Asked for in #106.

### Validation

Validation: 4350 runtime tests passed locally. All 1732 patch tests passed too.
